The airship has a smooth, cigar-shaped envelope with visible text on the side and a gondola suspended beneath the forward section. The background features numerous buildings under a cloudy sky.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is text on the side of the airship, but it is illegible and slightly distorted, typical of AI generation struggling with precise typography, though it mimics the look of branding.

The background buildings have a uniform, slightly smudged texture that lacks the sharp architectural detail expected in a high-resolution photo, suggesting generative blur rather than optical depth of field.
The surface is overly smooth and uniform, lacking the subtle panel lines, seams, or fabric texture often visible on real dirigibles, giving it a slightly 'plastic' or rendered appearance.

Clarity and coherence of text/branding on the hull
